name: riftcoach
description: Vanguard-safe live AI League of Legends coach

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,agent,desktop -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @riftcoach/api" "npm run dev -w @riftcoach/agent" "npm run dev -w @riftcoach/desktop"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @riftcoach/shared && npm run build -w @riftcoach/prompts && npm run build -w @riftcoach/api && npm run build -w @riftcoach/agent && npm run build -w @riftcoach/desktop
scripts.build:api: npm run build -w @riftcoach/shared && npm run build -w @riftcoach/prompts && npm run build -w @riftcoach/api
